headline.before: I built the booked-call funnel for your

bridge.title: Four things I noticed

beats.title: 140,000 subscribers. One premium offer, almost full.
beats.text: You've built 140K subscribers over 824 videos, a podcast and a newsletter of more than 40,000 people. Your premium offer is RPM at $3,000 for the first year, and the counter on the page says 289 of 300.

beats.title: Your viewers already own rentals.
beats.text: “How I Manage 96 Rental Units in 2 Hours a Week” reached 14,800 views in under two weeks, and your Shorts now ask how to live on the equity people have built. That's exactly the investor RPM is for.

beats.title: The application ends in an inbox, not a call.
beats.text: Someone clicks “Request your spot in RPM” and then waits 24 to 48 hours for an email. At the moment they're most ready to talk, there's no call to book, no thank-you page and nothing to prepare with.

beats.title: “It's almost full anyway.” That's when a call matters most.
beats.text: With 11 seats left and a cap of 300, each seat should go to the right investor. A short fit call does that, and it fills a waitlist instead of losing the people who apply after you're full.
beats.quote: “Most investors don't fail because they lack information.”

bridge.closing: So instead of explaining it, I built it. The page, the application, the emails and the ads, all below.

cards.body: The properties cash flow, yet you're still the one handling every call and repair.

cards.title: More doors feels like the only answer
cards.body: Everyone online says scale, and you're not sure that's the freedom you wanted.

cards.title: You've read enough
cards.body: You know the information. What you're missing is someone checking your numbers and your next move.

mechanism.title: Small and mighty: freedom from the portfolio you have.
mechanism.body: RPM isn't another course. It's a community of investors who already own rentals, with Chad's coaching, small groups and hot seats where your own deals and decisions get looked at. You leave with a plan that fits your life, not a bigger to-do list.

pillars.title: Your numbers checked
pillars.body: Underwriting, financing and cash flow, looked at by people who've done it.

pillars.title: Systems, not hustle
pillars.body: Management that gives you your time back.

pillars.title: The next deal, or none
pillars.body: Find the right one, or decide you have enough.

pillars.title: Living on your equity

preCallEmails.subject: You're booked: here's what happens next
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is booked for {{call_time}}. The link is in your calendar invite.

Before we talk:
1. Keep the time free.
2. Have a short list of your rentals ready: units, rough cash flow and what's on your mind.

One note: nobody on my team will ever ask you to pay through a DM. Payments only happen through the official links from this email address.

Talk soon,
Chad

preCallEmails.subject: More doors isn't the goal
preCallEmails.previewText: Why a plan beats one more tip
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Most investors I talk to don't need more information or more doors. They need someone to look at what they already own and help them decide the next move.

That's what RPM is for.

On the call we'll look at where you are today.

Chad

preCallEmails.subject: "I've taken your courses already"
preCallEmails.previewText: Then this is the next step
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Great, then you know how I think.

The courses give you the playbook. RPM is where we look at your own properties and decisions, with me and other investors who own rentals.

If you're not sure you need it, ask on the call. We'll tell you honestly.

Chad

preCallEmails.subject: What we'll cover on the call
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

The call takes about 30 minutes:

1. Where you are now and what you've tried.
2. Where you want to be in a year.
3. How the program works, what it costs, and whether it fits you.

If it isn't a fit, we'll tell you. No pressure either way.

Chad

preCallEmails.subject: Tomorrow: your call with Chad's team
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Quick reminder: your call is tomorrow at {{call_time}}.

If the time doesn't work anymore, reschedule with the link in your invite so someone else can take the slot.

See you tomorrow,
Chad

preCallEmails.subject: Today's the day
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is today at {{call_time}}. Find a quiet spot and have your questions ready.

Talk soon,
Chad
